title: fix(objectql)!: a roll-up summary field is read-only on create too, and a create seeds it as for an empty child list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFyg5B2muWbKZjA9phXVWse)_

Fixes #34672

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — skills/** teaches no starting value for a summary field (its only summary-write text, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, is about the backfill); `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx` now states the create side

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：汇总字段（`Field.summary`）在新建时也一律只读，不管作者有没有写 `readonly: true`。普通用户的 `POST`、批量/复合新建、导入（`insert`，以及 `upsert` 新建的那些行）、MCP `create_record`、非系统身份的流程新建，送来的汇总初值都被丢掉，在 `droppedFields` 里报 `readonly`，该列按「没有子记录」起步（`count`/`sum` 为 0，`min`/`max`/`avg` 为空）；开了 `strictReadonlyWrites` 则整笔拒收。顺带修好：写了 `readonly: true` 的汇总字段，新建时若带了值，过去会落成 `null`，现在落 0。
- 为什么改：#34752 只锁了更新；新建时普通用户仍可手填一个汇总初值，存下来被下游读，直到下一次子记录变动才被重算覆盖。spec 早已写明 `summary` 属于「never client-written」的计算类型（`COMPUTED_VALUE_TYPES`）。席位按路线 A 裁定（认领修正 6963962011）。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING）：今天给汇总字段带初值的非系统新建会被丢值或被拒。系统身份（`isSystem`）照写：种子数据、包安装、历史导入（`treatAsHistorical` 只许系统身份）都不受影响。Console 新建表单本来就不发汇总字段（见 Acceptance notes）。回滚即撤回本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`（`insertStaticReadonlySubject` 与新的 `withSummaryRollUpsReadonly`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts`（`staticReadonlyCreateStrip` 里的重新播种那 4 行）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-summary-update-lock.test.ts`（新建一侧的 describe）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-summary-update-lock.test.ts`，预期全过；新建一侧那组里「a person's create (REST POST)」断言两列都是 0、`droppedFields` 点名两个字段。
- 需要你做的：无。`check-governed-merges` 判定非受管；L1 与席位的收窄契约复审通过后由区落地。

## What changes

A roll-up `summary` field is read-only on create too, whether or not the author declared `readonly: true`, and a create that had its value taken starts the column at the empty-child-list seed.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`
  - `insertStaticReadonlySubject(schema, wallJudgesOrganization)` is the one schema view the three create-side static `readonly` passes read: the pre-hook withhold (what `beforeInsert` is shown), the post-hook strip in `engine-insert.ts` (what is stored) and the `insert`-mode preview in `engine-validate.ts`. It now reads every roll-up as `readonly: true` before `staticReadonlyInsertSubject` judges the schema, so that function's exclusions (a `sys_` object, a platform-internal `managedBy` bucket) hold for roll-ups too. `isSystem` runs none of these passes and keeps its value.
  - New private helper `withSummaryRollUpsReadonly(schema)`: the one spelling of the roll-up lock, read by both the insert view and `updateStaticReadonlySubject` (the update half, #34752, now reads it instead of its own loop; no update answer changes).
  - `summaryFieldsLockedOnUpdate` is renamed `summaryFieldsLockedOnWrite` (it now answers both verbs). It is a module export of `engine-top-level.ts`, not a package export: `packages/objectql/dist/index.d.ts` names neither spelling.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts`: `staticReadonlyCreateStrip` re-runs `initializeSummaryFields` over the stripped row after its re-default and copies the seed back for the TAKEN keys only. Without it the strip re-ran `applyFieldDefaults` alone, so a taken roll-up landed `null` while the write succeeded: the state the summary seed exists to rule out. That already happened before this PR for a roll-up declared `readonly: true` (route condition 1); it is fixed here for both.
- `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`: the `summary` note on `RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES` (the #6014 note) is rewritten. It keeps "do not add `summary` to this set" and says why the type rides the static `readonly` strip instead (the `isSystem`-only exemption, and the re-seed); it retires "supplying an initial value is a SUPPORTED authoring path" for an ordinary caller, per the route ruling.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`: the summary paragraph now covers create and update.
- `.changeset/34672-summary-readonly-on-create.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/objectql`, BREAKING, the migration line for REST, import and MCP clients, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- `.changeset/34672-summary-readonly-on-update.md`: DELIBERATE CORRECTION, see Acceptance notes.

No new drop reason, no spec key: reason `readonly`, as on update.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-summary-update-lock.test.ts`, new describe "a roll-up summary is read-only on create" (14 cases), real `ObjectQL` and a recording driver, `order_total` a `sum` roll-up without `readonly` beside `order_total_ro` declared `readonly: true`, written as a signed-in person unless stated:
  - baseline: a create naming neither stores `0` and `0`, reports nothing;
  - the REST POST shape: both values dropped and reported in one event, both columns `0`, the rest stored, the returned row `0`;
  - condition 1: the declared `readonly: true` roll-up alone lands `0`, not `null` (the driver's create payload is asserted);
  - a `null` starting value is taken the same way and lands `0`;
  - a batch (array) create and `insertMany` (the import commit; the row that sent a value carries `droppedFields`, the other none);
  - `strictReadonlyWrites`: refused (`code` `ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED`, `fields`, `drops`, `operation: 'insert'`), nothing written;
  - the `insert`-mode preview reports the same drop;
  - a `beforeInsert` hook is shown the seed, not the caller's value;
  - children already stored before the parent: the create lands `0`, not the typed value; the next child write recomputes to the true sum;
  - `isSystem` keeps `90` and `90` (seed loads, package installs, historical imports);
  - `preserveAudit` without `isSystem` is no exemption;
  - a `max` roll-up (no empty-set value) is dropped and stays empty;
  - a `sys_` object stays outside the create lock.
- `packages/rest/src/import-summary-update-lock-34672.test.ts`, new describe (3 cases), real ObjectQL + protocol + SQLite `:memory:` over the HTTP routes as a signed-in person, reading the physical row: `POST /api/v1/data/:object` (201, `droppedFields` names both, both columns `0`); import `writeMode: 'insert'` dry run and commit (row 1 carries `droppedFields`, stored `0`); import `writeMode: 'upsert'` (drops on the updated row and on the created row; a created row whose children were already stored lands `0`, and the next child `POST` recomputes to `51`).
- Changed pins, each forced by the narrowing and each now stating the new expectation (route condition 4; no pin deleted):
  1. `engine-summary-update-lock.test.ts` "INSERT is not narrowed: a caller's initial value is kept" → "INSERT is narrowed too: a person's starting value is dropped, reported, and the column seeded 0".
  2. `summary-rollup.test.ts` "never overwrites a value the author supplied on insert" → "never overwrites a value a system writer supplied on insert (seed data, a historical import)": the same assertion, now written with `isSystem: true`, the only writer that may still supply one; beside it a new case, "an ordinary caller's value on insert is dropped, and the seed fills the column" (`0` and `0`).
  3. `summary-rollup.test.ts` "seeds every row of a batch insert, and only the unsupplied ones" → the same assertions with a system writer.
  4.–7. `engine-blank-typed-value-door.test.ts`, the four insert cases (`""` one row, `"  "` one row, array + `insertMany`, "a valid value on every typed column … (the roll-up's is dropped)"): every other typed column still reaches the driver as `null` / unchanged, and no `f_summary` is sent on create, as it already was not on update (the shared `expectTypedNull` now says so for both verbs).
  8. `packages/rest/src/rest-data-blank-typed-value.test.ts`: the fixture `seed` helper writes as the system principal (that is the writer that may still set `f_summary: 7`); "a valid value on every typed column" now expects `droppedFields` naming `f_summary` and the column `null` (this fixture's roll-up declares no `summaryOperations`, so there is no seed).

Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; the objectql suites import the engine from source, so no build sits between the edit and the run):
- The lock, `engine-top-level.ts` `staticReadonlyInsertSubject(withSummaryRollUpsReadonly(schema) as any)` → `staticReadonlyInsertSubject(schema as any)` (anchor x1 → x0, blob `853f70980a4d` → `4c1dc5b1d8f4`): `Tests 16 failed | 91 passed (107)`. Red: the flipped insert pin, 10 of the 14 create cases, the ordinary-caller `summary-rollup` case and the 4 blank-door insert cases. Green, as predicted: the baseline, the declared `readonly: true` case (the declared flag is taken without the lock), `isSystem`, `sys_`, every update case and the system-writer `summary-rollup` cases.
- The re-seed, `engine-insert.ts` `if (stripped[k] == null && reseeded[k] !== undefined) stripped[k] = reseeded[k];` → `void reseeded[k];` (blob `0b8e11afbbae` → `3c2e0b671768`): `Tests 10 failed | 97 passed (107)`. Red includes condition 1's pin ("the declared readonly: true roll-up alone lands 0, not null"); green: the baseline, `isSystem`, the `max` case, `sys_`, strict, preview and every update case.

## Acceptance notes

- Console create form (route condition 2), measured on this head: the Console does NOT send a summary field on create. `ObjectForm` builds its create payload with `formWritePayload` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/writePayload.ts`), whose first step is `sanitizeFormData`; `ModalForm` and `DrawerForm` call `sanitizeFormData` directly; the master-detail batch sanitizes child rows the same way. `sanitizeFormData` drops every field whose type is in `COMPUTED_FIELD_TYPES` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sanitize.ts`, `summary` a member) whenever the object schema is supplied, and `ObjectForm` renders a summary control disabled. Existing pins: `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sanitize.test.ts` "drops computed / read-only field types when a schema is provided" (`task_count: { type: 'summary' }` dropped) and `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/masterDetailTx.test.ts` "buildMasterDetailBatch strips computed/server-managed child fields" (a child `summary` dropped from the create op); both run on this head, `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 21 passed (21)`. The import mapping also offers no summary target (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/importTargetFields.ts`, `COMPUTED_TYPES`). One edge, harmless after this PR: a form built only from inline `customFields` sanitizes with no schema, so a summary there would not be filtered client-side; the engine now drops and reports it. No `ui/` change.
- DELIBERATE CORRECTION of an unreleased changeset, `.changeset/34672-summary-readonly-on-update.md` (#34752's, not yet consumed by a release), two sentences, because they state the create-side answer this PR reverses:
  - was "An import with `writeMode: 'upsert'` drops the value on the rows it updates and keeps it on the rows it creates." now "An import with `writeMode: 'upsert'` drops the value on the rows it updates; the rows it creates are covered by the create-side entry (`34672-summary-readonly-on-create`)."
  - was "Not changed: a create keeps a value sent for a summary field as its starting value, …" now "Not changed by this entry: the create side, which the create-side entry (`34672-summary-readonly-on-create`) narrows in the same release; seed data and a historical import, which write as the system principal, still carry a pre-computed total on create."
  The dispatch order for this round names both changesets in the file surface.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` reports one overlap, with #33849 (`chore: version packages`) on that same changeset: the Version Packages PR deletes the file it consumes and this PR edits it. It is regenerated from `main`, so it is no queue; every other candidate (#34978, #34817, #34709) and `origin/main` merge cleanly.
- The rename `summaryFieldsLockedOnUpdate` → `summaryFieldsLockedOnWrite` has no caller outside `packages/objectql/src` (`git grep`), and `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` reports `0 lost`.
- Started from the lost round's pushed head `4f08aded` (Resume-from); the work was reviewed against route A and its five conditions and found complete; this round added a merge of `main` and the verification below. The `(wip)` subject on `5430eb9a` is left in history, not rewritten.
